history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A person wearing a black hoodie and black shorts stands on a wet, sandy beach. The person's face is obscured by the hood of the hoodie, and they are looking out towards the ocean. The beach is covered in small rocks and debris, and the tide appears to be out, revealing a vast expanse of wet sand. In the background, the ocean stretches to the horizon, meeting a soft, overcast sky with a hint of pink and blue. A distant, misty island or landmass is visible in the far distance. The lighting is soft and diffused, characteristic of twilight or an overcast day, creating a calm and slightly melancholic mood. The color palette is muted, dominated by shades of grey, black, and pale blues and pinks in the sky. The overall style is realistic, with a focus on the natural elements of the landscape and the solitary figure. The image has a slightly grainy, low-light quality, adding to the atmospheric feel.
